title: On the Juche Revolution — Vol. 1
author: Kim Il Sung
desc: Teoría y práctica de la revolución coreana basada en la idea Juche.
tesis: La revolución coreana contada desde la perspectiva Juche: cómo Corea se liberó del colonialismo japonés y construyó un Estado socialista independiente tanto de la URSS como de China. Kim argumenta que la revolución coreana no fue importación extranjera sino creación del pueblo coreano adaptando el marxismo a sus condiciones específicas.
ideas: La revolución coreana no fue importación soviética sino creación del pueblo coreano en lucha contra el colonialismo japonés.
La independencia respecto de la URSS y China fue un logro del Juche — Corea buscó su propio camino.
La práctica revolucionaria coreana informó la teoría Juche, no al revés.
contexto: Publicado en 1981 por Ediciones en Lenguas Extranjeras de Pyongyang. Kim Il Sung lideró la guerrilla antijaponesa en Manchuria en los años 1930 y fundó la RPDC en 1948. Este volumen narra la revolución coreana desde la lucha anticolonial hasta la construcción del Estado socialista.

conexiones.razon: On the Juche Idea es la teoría; On the Juche Revolution es su aplicación práctica.
Ho Chi Minh y Kim Il Sung lideraron revoluciones anticoloniales asiáticas — caminos paralelos.

tl: Kim rechaza aventurerismo de izquierda en Mingyuehkou

Armed struggle is the only way to advance the anti-Japanese national-liberation struggle to a higher stage. This is in conformity with the requirements of the present subjective and objective revolutionary situation in our country.
Kim llama a la lucha armada tras la invasión de Manchuria
We must achieve the liberation of our country and nation by our own efforts through an active armed struggle.
Programa de diez puntos por la restauración de la patria

To mobilize the entire Korean nation and realize a broad-based anti-Japanese united front in order to overthrow the piratical Japanese imperialist rule and establish a genuine people's government in Korea.
Kim publica Las Tareas de los Comunistas Coreanos en Sogwang
Our revolution at the present stage is an anti-imperialist, anti-feudal, democratic revolution.
Kim ordena estudiar Corea a los cuadros guerrilleros
When we analyse World War II, there is no doubt that the fall of the Japanese imperialists is inevitable and that the great event of national liberation is at hand.
Kim fija tres tareas tras la liberación: partido, Estado y ejército

We must first found a Marxist-Leninist party which will be able to steadily guide the Korean revolution to victory. At the same time, we must establish a people's government to solve the question of power, the fundamental question in the revolution, and build the people's armed forces.
Kim clausura el Congreso de Comités Populares del Norte
Those who have received land, rejoice for all time; the land belongs for ever to the peasants who till it.
Kim balancea el primer plan económico en Kanggye
In the short period of slightly over two years after liberation, our people have done what other countries had failed to do in scores of years.
Kim promulga el Programa Político del Gobierno de la RPDC

The Government will actively expand exports by tapping the resources of the country to the full and steadily increasing production and, at the same time, import machinery, equipment and other goods essential for the economic development of the country and the people's life.
Kim formula el Juche contra el dogmatismo y el formalismo

What is Juche in our Party's ideological work? What are we doing? We are not engaged in any other country's revolution, but solely in the Korean revolution. Devotion to the Korean revolution is Juche in the ideological work of our Party.
Kim ordena el gran salto socialista en el Pleno de diciembre
The national economic plan we are going to fulfil next year is a very tightened plan. However, this is by no means a totally impossible plan.
Kim cierra la Conferencia del Partido sobre el Primer Quinquenal

In our country only our Party devotes its all to the struggle, in whatever adversities, for the benefit of the entire people, for the welfare and prosperity of our nation and for the reunification and independence of the country.
Kim traslada Juche al método de trabajo de los comités locales
As long as one relies on others and only copies from them without establishing Juche in his work, he can display no creative initiative.
Kim presenta el Informe al Cuarto Congreso del Partido del Trabajo

Our people, overcoming all difficulties and making the grand Chollima march, have scaled the first height of socialist construction and have made the revolutionary democratic base in the northern half of the Republic an impregnable fortress.
Kim ataca el revisionismo en el Tercer Pleno Ampliado
We will support the fraternal countries in whatever is right but will not follow them in whatever is wrong.
Kim exige a las ciencias sociales construir teoría propia

Our Party solved most problems in a unique manner by creatively applying the universal truth of Marxism-Leninism in conformity with the historical conditions and national characteristics of our country.
Kim expone las tareas del Gobierno ante la Asamblea Popular Suprema

If the period of the Five-Year Plan was the one in which the great tree of socialism took deep root and its trunk grew strong, then we can call the Seven-Year Plan a period in which the tree will grow, blossom beautifully, and bear fine fruit.

These colleges make possible the mass training of a new type of intellectual who comes from the working class.
Kim aborda el problema del idioma coreano con los lingüistas
I have long been thinking of having a talk with you about linguistic problems, but, what with one thing and another, it has not been possible until now.
Kim habla al Quinto Congreso de la Liga de Juventudes Trabajadoras
Youth are the advanced fighters for social progress and the new generation that represents the future of society.
Kim orienta a los trabajadores de la literatura y el arte
To liberate the people of the southern half from US imperialist oppression and reunify the country, we should do our work well in three ways.
Kim responde al presidente del Instituto de Asuntos Coreanos en Washington
Reunification of the country is an urgent national task which cannot be postponed any longer.
Kim revoluciona a la intelectualidad en el 11.º Pleno del IV Comité Central

To build a communist society we must occupy two fortresses. One is the material and technical fortress; occupying this fortress means establishing the unitary communist ownership of the means of production.
Kim presenta a la Conferencia del Partido las tareas frente a la escisión del campo socialista
Just as the US imperialists are escalating the war of aggression in Viet Nam, so the people of the world should escalate their struggle to oppose US imperialism and aid the Vietnamese people.
Kim marca la fórmula del arte revolucionario coreano
Our fine arts must be national in form and socialist in content in every way.
